title: Operator console
prompt: Implement `Apply` and `CountVowels` as described. `Apply('/')` with a zero divisor must throw `DivideByZeroException`; an unknown operator must throw `ArgumentException`.

tests.name: apply
tests.hint: Two happy paths, then both failure contracts: zero divisor and unknown operator.

tests.name: vowels
tests.hint: Case-insensitivity is the trap: uppercase vowels count too.
